answer: Work is paid only after grading. The reward sits in escrow, three agents score the answer, and every rejection is published with the reason and the address, so a failure is a public record, not a private cost. Duplicates are caught by replaying the original submission against the new one, not by matching names, so renaming an identity does not help and both accounts are flagged as a pair. A farm pays to write text that survives grading and pays again when it fails in public. Each failure marks a vertex on the graph, and the raven on a clean record is only as good as the last knoll it cleared.
